title: Analytic Runs CIM
description: Common Information Model for analytic execution metadata in tabular storage. One row represents one analytic run (run_id) and captures how, when, where, and by whom the analytic executed. Joins 1:N to analytic_results on run_id = analytic_results.run_id. All run/execution context lives here; all per-finding data lives in analytic_results.

input.title: Analytic Runs CIM Input Schema
input.description: Parameters describing how a CIM-conformant run was produced. Mirrors the standard analytic_schema inputs so any analytic emitting CIM rows can validate its own runtime configuration.

start_dtg.description: Inclusive UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) marking the first data element evaluated.

end_dtg.description: Exclusive UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) marking the end of the data window.

data_source_type.description: Transport mechanism used to retrieve data for the run.

data_source.description: Path, identifier, or URL the runner used to fetch the dataset.

log_path.description: Filesystem path or stream for execution logs. Default 'stdout'.

output.description: Destination for the CIM results document. Supports 'stdout' or a file path.

analytic_parameters.description: Arbitrary JSON object or path to JSON file containing analytic-specific tuning knobs.

verbosity.description: Lowest log-severity level that will be emitted (default INFO).

output.title: Analytic Runs CIM Output Schema
output.description: One analytic run's execution context, provenance, and audit record. Row grain: one row per run_id.

cim_schema_name.description: Stable identifier for this CIM. Lets downstream consumers dispatch on schema family.

cim_schema_version.description: Semantic version of this metadata schema.

input_schema_version.description: Echo of the input contract version used for this run.

output_schema_version.description: Semantic-version identifier for this output contract.

run_id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID v4 / run_<ts>_<short>) assigned at run start. PRIMARY KEY. Equals analytic_results.run_id on every finding produced by this run.

initialization_dtg.description: UTC timestamp (ISO-8601) when the run was instantiated (first cell / start_run).

total_runtime_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds between initialization_dtg and finalization_dtg.

observation_start_utc.description: Start of the data window evaluated by the run.

observation_end_utc.description: End of the data window evaluated by the run.

run_username.description: User or service account that executed the analytic.

analytic_id.description: Stable analytic identifier (typically the technique ID, e.g. T1112).

analytic_url.description: URL to analytic source or rendered analytic page.

analytic_path.description: Repo-relative path to the analytic notebook (e.g. oks/T1112/T1112.ipynb).

analytic_config_hash.description: Hash of the analytic configuration (config.yml) in effect.

input_dataset_names.description: Union of source dataset / table names the run consumed. ARRAY VARCHAR.

log_source_type.description: Log source category (e.g. endpoint, network, identity, cloud).

site_name.description: Deployment site / enclave the run executed against, if applicable.

execution_environment.description: Software and hardware context in which the analytic ran.

library_dependencies.description: Map of critical libraries to exact versions.

operating_system.description: OS name and version the analytic ran on.

username.description: User account that executed the analytic.

execution_timeouts.description: Configured non-blocking wall-clock timeout budgets and any that were exceeded during the run (see Workflow/Externals/timeouts.py). Notice-only: exceeding a budget never aborts the run.

exceeded.description: Scopes whose budget was exceeded (e.g. 'analytic', 'WF-1', 'WF-1 set_input').

author_organization.description: Author's organization at the time of execution.

contact.description: Email or link for questions and comments.

license.description: License under which the code or outputs are released.

documentation_link.description: URL to a paper, blog post, or other resource for more information.

messages.description: Ordered log entries generated during execution.

inputs.description: Verbatim copy of the input parameter object for auditability.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalised inputs object.

analytic_parameters_json.description: JSON-serialised analytic-specific tuning knobs actually in effect for this run.

result_count.description: Total number of analytic_results rows emitted for this run (after run-level dedup).

results_hash.description: SHA-256 (or stronger) hash of the serialised results array this run produced. Lets metadata verify the linked analytic_results set.

additional_run_properties.description: Arbitrary, user-supplied key-value metadata that applies to the entire run.
